teaser: Rusk wrote his sixth line into the green journal so that the farm's first choosing would stand in the book and not in one old woman's memory, and Verrin would not say the name twice for a page. The plant answered the line with nothing at all, not one leaf in three days, and on the third morning the count took the officer's left eye — the first eye on Hesper, with a line that still stands and a ladder that has nothing left on it. What moved the plant this week was a quarter turn of a wheel at the seat where its water comes in, and the farm's own gauge said so in a tenth of a point.
